description: Generates polyphonic test signals, pitch and velocity and gate, from nine built-in patterns, four of them played from MIDI files

params.text: Sets the tempo, 15 to 480 beats per minute, with 120 at the default setting
Sets how many polyphonic channels are generated, 1 to 16, raised where the chosen pattern needs more
Picks the pattern: RND TUNE, ARPS, CIRC O 5, RND CHRD, CHAOS, GOLDBERG, LV BEETH, CHOPIN or DEBUSSY
Sets the one extra control a pattern offers, density for CHAOS and which piece is played for the MIDI patterns, with the lamp lit while the chosen pattern reads it

outputs.text: The pitch of each generated note in volts per octave
The velocity of each generated note, 0V to 10V
A 10V gate for as long as each generated note sounds
